description: On a writable copy of the base fixture TableDef T's ValidationRule is set to '[ID] < 100' and ValidationText to 'ID must be below 100' (each read back, DBEngine.Errors). Then INSERT INTO T (ID, A) with ID 200 and with ID 5 are run with dbFailOnError (DBEngine.Errors after each), and a dbOpenDynaset Recordset on T has AddNew, ID = 300 and Update called (DBEngine.Errors). Afterwards the rows of T are read.
retentionNote: Designed r-cat-1b probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
